title: Reordered Power of 2
description: Check if any permutation of the digits of n is a power of two.
pseudocode:
1. Convert n to a sorted string of digits
2. Iterate through powers of 2 from 2^0 to 2^29
3. Convert each power to a sorted string of digits
4. Compare sorted strings; return true if match

steps.note: Convert n=1 to sorted digit string representation
Sorted digits of n (1) match sorted digits of power (1). Return true.
